COMPONENTS / HUB75-FRAME-COUPLER-EDGE

HUB75 Frame Coupler — Edge

Configured straight edge coupler for a HUB75 display frame

Built in SolidCraft 0.49.0 733 commands HUB75 Frame Coupler · all variants

Model preview

Native Small/Medium/Large straight edge member from the shared coupler family. Small and Medium suppress the single stepped panel-pin pass-through; Large enables that same authored revolve cut.

Key dimensions: Small / Medium / Large; Medium default; 80 mm default size; 4 mm wall; 3 mm base; 6 mm guide; 2 × Ø3.4 mounting bores

Files

Source stays on the source branch; generated CAD artifacts stay on the durable build branch.

SCPF source Command JSON ↗ SolidCraft .sc ↗ View STL on GitHub ↗ Download STL STEP ↗ model.yml ci.yml

Generated files are not republished in gh-pages; these links point to the accepted build scope.

Construction stages

  • Build the source-derived configured edge base and guide stock
  • Preserve the native TOP-edge T clip and rounded guide ends
  • Add the two bushing support zones, mounting bores and locator pads
  • Cut the source two-section tapered rail clearance
  • Cut native reference tick marks and blind tapered reference holes
  • Control the exact stepped panel-pin pass-through from the native configuration table
